items.exampleEn: Good journalism checks every fact before it is printed.
items.exampleZh: 好的新聞工作會在刊出前查證每一個事實。

items.exampleEn: The actor hates publicity and rarely gives interviews.
items.exampleZh: 那位演員討厭受到媒體關注，很少接受訪問。

items.exampleEn: My father reads the editorials before any other page of the newspaper.
items.exampleZh: 我爸爸看報紙時，會先讀社論再看其他版面。

items.exampleEn: The publication of the new dictionary took ten years.
items.exampleZh: 這本新字典的出版花了十年。

items.exampleEn: This channel has lost many young viewers to online videos.
items.exampleZh: 這個頻道有很多年輕觀眾都跑去看網路影片了。

items.exampleEn: Don't believe everything you read in the tabloids.
items.exampleZh: 不要相信八卦小報上寫的每一件事。

items.exampleEn: The soundtrack of this game was played by a real orchestra.
items.exampleZh: 這款遊戲的配樂是由真正的管弦樂團演奏的。

items.exampleEn: The newscaster suddenly laughed when a dog ran into the studio.
items.exampleZh: 一隻狗跑進攝影棚時，新聞主播突然笑了出來。

items.exampleEn: This book about home cooking has been a bestseller for three years.
items.exampleZh: 這本關於家常菜的書已經暢銷三年了。

items.sentenceEn: She studied journalism and now writes for a local newspaper.
items.sentenceZh: 她念新聞，現在替一家地方報紙寫稿。

items.audioEn: I bought the soundtrack of the film because the songs were so beautiful.
items.audioZh: 我買了那部電影的原聲帶，因為裡面的歌非常好聽。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼買了電影原聲帶？
options: It was a gift for a friend
The film was on sale this week
The songs were cheap to buy

items.sentenceEn: My aunt worked as a newscaster for a radio station in Tainan.
items.sentenceZh: 我阿姨以前在台南的一家廣播電台當新聞播報員。

items.sentenceEn: Many viewers called the station to complain about the ending.
items.sentenceZh: 很多觀眾打電話到電視台抱怨結局。

items.stemEn: This phone was the company's biggest ____ last year; it sold ten million.
items.stemZh: 這支手機是那家公司去年最暢銷的商品，賣出了一千萬支。

items.stemEn: The city's new bridge got a lot of ____ because of its unusual shape.
items.stemZh: 市區的新橋因為造型特別，受到很多關注。

items.passageEn: Amy Lin worked in journalism for twenty years before she wrote her first novel. During those years, she wrote editorials for a serious newspaper and sometimes laughed at the tabloids, which cared more about famous people's love lives than real news. After its publication last spring, her novel quickly became a bestseller. The publicity started when a popular newscaster talked about the book on TV, and thousands of viewers ordered it that night. Now a film company wants to make it into a movie, and a famous band has agreed to write the soundtrack. Amy still reads the news every morning, but now the media often writes about her.
items.passageZh: Amy Lin 在新聞界工作了二十年，才寫出她的第一本小說。那些年裡，她替一家嚴肅的報紙寫社論，有時也會取笑那些八卦小報，因為它們比較在乎名人的戀愛生活，而不是真正的新聞。她的小說去年春天出版後，很快就成了暢銷書。這波宣傳是從一位很受歡迎的新聞主播在電視上談到這本書開始的，當晚就有數千名觀眾訂購。現在有一家電影公司想把它拍成電影，一個知名樂團也答應為電影寫配樂。Amy 仍然每天早上看新聞，但現在媒體常常寫到她。

questions.questionZh: 這本小說為什麼開始受到關注？
options: 她在報紙社論裡推薦自己的書
一位主播在電視上介紹它
請 Amy 寫電影配樂
收購她以前工作的報社

items.promptZh: 今天報紙的社論在談空氣汙染。
referenceEn: Today's editorial in the newspaper is about air pollution.
The newspaper's editorial today discusses air pollution.
rubricZh: editorial 指社論（例如 today's editorial、the newspaper's editorial 等）
「在談」可寫，例如 is about、discusses、talks about 等

items.instructionZh: 用 soundtrack 造一個句子，說說你喜歡的一部電影、影集或卡通的配樂。
referenceEn: That old cartoon has a soundtrack I still listen to.
My favorite movie has a soundtrack that always makes me feel calm.
rubricZh: soundtrack 的用法，例如 has a soundtrack、the soundtrack of the film 等
時態合理（例如 has、listen 等）
